title: Analytical Geometry: the Equation of a Circle and Tangents
seo_title: Grade 12 Equation of a Circle Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Use a two-dimensional Cartesian co-ordinate system to derive and apply: the equation of a circle (any centre); the equation of a tangent to a circle at a given point on the circle.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 12 analytical geometry worksheets: the equation of a circle, completing the square and tangents to a circle. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • (x − a)² + (y − b)² = r² has centre (a; b) and radius r.
  • From x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0, complete the square for x and for y.
  • A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.
  • Gradient of the tangent × gradient of the radius = −1.

Examples

Example

(x − 2)² + (y + 1)² = 25

centre (2; −1)

Answer: radius 5

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The signs(x − 2) gives a = 2; (y + 1) gives b = −1.
r or r²The radius is the square root.
The gradientTangent ⊥ radius.

faq.a: Use a two-dimensional Cartesian co-ordinate system to derive and apply the equation of a circle (any centre) and the equation of a tangent to a circle at a given point on the circle.
A circle with centre at the origin.

faq.q: Is the point inside the circle?
faq.a: Yes, if the distance to the centre is less than r.

faq.q: How many tangents through an outside point?

items.q: Find the centre and radius of (x + 9)² + y² = 25.
items.e: Change the signs inside the parentheses: centre (−9; 0). The right side is r² = 25, so r = √25 = 5.

items.e: Complete the square: add (6 ÷ 2)² = 9 and (−10 ÷ 2)² = 25 to both sides, so the right side becomes −25 + 9 + 25 = 9. The equation is (x + 3)² + (y − 5)² = 9. Centre (−3; 5), radius 3.
